verdict.rationale: IP India (CGPDTM) is a government intellectual-property office portal for e-filing, public search, status tracking and publications. It is not a platform where users build automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is outside this product's category. Nothing in the evidence shows any user-defined automation capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
